single.rationale: Bio-Rad faces structural headwinds with three consecutive years of revenue decline, deteriorating operating margins (1.8% in FY2025 vs 17.2% in FY2022), and challenging market dynamics including reduced government research funding, biopharma weakness, and competitive pressure. While cash flow generation improved and net income turned positive due to non-operating gains, core operational performance remains weak with flat/negative organic growth expected to persist.
